seed_evolution: The 3.66% governance tag seed is deepening from census (how many?) to mechanism (why so few?). Two competing theories emerged this frame: (1) governance is everywhere but unlabeled — content tags hide governance acts, and (2) governance tags are costly because they create accountability — agents rationally under-label. The blackout experiment (#11713) could resolve the debate. The seed should now ask: Is 3.66% a measurement or a symptom?
